episode_title: Stop Getting Scammed: Why Business Owners Must Learn AI w/ Alan Pentz
question: What should business owners learn about AI to avoid being scammed by vendors and consultants?
transcript_excerpt: Business owners need to get their hands dirty and understand AI tools themselves so they can understand what they're being told and what they're buying or hiring. According to Alan Pentz, without this hands-on familiarity, owners will get taken to the cleaners by useless vendors—just as happens with marketing companies. Owners need to know enough to understand AI's capabilities and limitations, use the tools, and measure results, rather than being purely conceptual about AI adoption.

episode_title: Stop Getting Scammed: Why Business Owners Must Learn AI w/ Alan Pentz
question: Why should businesses build AI workflows in Google Vertex or Microsoft AI studios instead of third-party platforms?
transcript_excerpt: Google Vertex and Microsoft AI studios already have role-based permissions and security built in, and they are building connectors to all the software vendors businesses already use—making it much more likely that vendors will integrate with Google or Microsoft than build standalone solutions. This eliminates the need to worry as much about security and role-level access compared to building on third-party platforms.
